CustomField.description: Salesforce matching rules used to find existing Contacts for this section's related records during conversion. Leave blank to check every active Contact matching rule. The section never inherits the Form Template's Contact Matching Rules. Works with Update Most Confident Contact, which decides what happens when several Contacts match.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose which Contact matching rules conversion uses for this section's data. Leave blank to check every active Contact matching rule; pair with Update Most Confident Contact to control how multiple matches resolve.
CustomField.label: Contact Matching Rules
